code.name: Family trade carried forward to new country
code.definition: Passages where an occupational skill or business owned in the home country is reproduced by the same household in the destination, often with the same family members continuing the work.

code.name: Tenement living conditions on arrival
code.definition: Passages describing the physical housing — walkups, shared bathrooms, coin-operated meters — that immigrants move into after arriving in American cities.

code.name: Children kept from school to work in family business
code.definition: Passages where immigrant children are pulled out of school or never enrolled so they can contribute labor to a household enterprise.

code.name: Conscription avoidance as emigration motive
code.definition: Passages where a male family member leaves the home country to avoid being called into military service.

code.name: Children left behind during staged migration
code.definition: Passages where family members, particularly children, are left in the home country during migration because the household cannot afford to bring them, with the expectation of later reunion.
